description:
The committed MCP production dependency graph is advisory-free while preserving schema-generated server startup and protocol behavior.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=info exits zero in mcp-server/ against the committed package-lock.json with no audit exception.
- [hard] REQ-02: MCP unit, integration, startup, initialize, and tools/list tests pass with the release CLI schema after the dependency changes.
- [hard] REQ-03: Any SDK or validation API migration updates every affected MCP consumer and regression test in the same change.

## Notes

Blast radius: `mcp-server/package.json`, `mcp-server/package-lock.json`, and affected `mcp-server/` implementation/tests; CLI behavior remains a consumed schema contract.
title: Remediate MCP production dependency advisories
